item.title: Paramount Skydance CEO Calls AI Cinema's Biggest Creative Breakthrough
item.description:
Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison likened AI to the 1990s CGI revolution, calling it potentially the biggest creative breakthrough in film history. Citing The Terminator's cost gap, he argued AI can slash production budgets, lower risk and unlock more original storytelling.

item.title: Google Gemini Adds Memory Summary With View Edit and Delete Controls
item.description:
Google is rolling out a Memory summary feature for Gemini that organizes the personal information the AI has collected into categories such as background, relationships, work, interests and preferences. Users can view, edit and delete individual items and review modification history, with the entry point under Personal Intelligence in Settings; it is initially limited to US English users aged 18+ with a Google AI subscription, while the web version already supports Simplified Chinese.

原文标题：Gemini 上线记忆摘要 支持查看编辑删除个人信息

Why it matters：记忆透明度与用户可控性是消费级 AI 助手的关键产品演进，值得关注。

item.title: Sutton Pushes Back on Bitter Lesson Misreading as Brute Force Alone
item.description:
Richard Sutton, author of The Bitter Lesson, clarified on X that brute-force computation alone cannot yield genuine intelligence and that clever new methods are still needed. Commentators add that the essay targets hardcoding human ingenuity into systems, not algorithmic or architectural innovation.

原文标题：Sutton 回应苦涩的教训被误读 称暴力计算不足

Why it matters：对 AI 圈流行的唯算力论解读做出权威纠偏，厘清了算法创新与硬编码人类知识的边界。

item.title: Rapidus 2nm Mass Production at Risk as SRAM Milestone Slips
item.description:
Bloomberg reports that Japan's Rapidus has failed to deliver usable SRAM by its planned summer 2026 milestone, putting its fiscal 2027 2nm mass-production target at risk of a multi-month delay. SRAM is a critical cache component for advanced logic and AI accelerators, and its yield directly gates process viability. Rapidus said it remains committed to starting mass production in the second half of fiscal 2027, with chairman Tetsuro Higashi insisting last month that the roadmap was on track.

原文标题：Rapidus 2nm 量产受阻 SRAM 里程碑延误数月

Why it matters：日本最受关注的先进制程项目出现实质性进度滑期，直接牵动全球 2nm 代工格局与 AI 芯片供给预期。

item.title: Amazon Replaces Sonnet 4.6 with Strands Decider to Cut Token Costs 98%
item.description:
Amazon's internal ticketing system swapped Claude Sonnet 4.6 for Strands Decider, a decision model launched a month ago, achieving comparable labeling quality at 98% lower token cost and saving millions of dollars annually. The key insight is reframing open-ended text generation as a constrained decision problem over fixed labels, letting a specialized decision model replace a general-purpose LLM.

原文标题：亚马逊用决策模型替代 Sonnet 4.6 省下数百万美元

Why it matters：以真实生产系统的大规模替换案例，量化了专用决策模型对通用大模型的成本替代效应，对做分类类 Agent 的团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Unveils Claude Fable 5.2 Topping Coding Benchmarks Over GPT-6 Astra
item.description:
Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, claiming notable gains across coding, reasoning, scientific research, cybersecurity and robotics, with up to 30% faster output and 20% lower cost. Fable 5.2 scored 49.1% on the agentic coding benchmark FrontierCode 2.0, beating GPT-6 Astra at 42.8% and Gemini 4 Carbon at 41.1%, and also led on multidisciplinary reasoning tests. Anthropic demonstrated it coordinating over 1,000 agents over eight days to build a bootable operating system from scratch.

原文标题：Anthropic 发布 Claude Fable 5.2 编程基准超越 GPT-6 Astra

Why it matters：头部厂商新一代旗舰模型发布并登顶多项基准，是 AI 时间线上的关键节点。

item.title: Mistral CEO Warns Centralized AI Labs Will Encroach on Customer Business
item.description:
Mistral CEO Arthur Mensch argues on the 20VC podcast that if enterprises depend on just two or three centralized AI providers, those vendors will use customer-generated data to build better systems and then compete directly with those customers' businesses, a scenario he says is already priced into today's market. The argument serves as a strategic case for open and self-hosted AI deployment.

原文标题：Mistral CEO 警告集中式 AI 实验室将反噬客户业务

Why it matters：来自欧洲头部开源模型厂商 CEO 对集中式 AI 商业模式的直接批评，涉及数据主权与供应商锁定，对判断行业格局有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Prompt Tweak Quintuples Claude Code Refactoring Success
item.description:
Anthropic documentation reveals that simply telling Claude Fable 5.2 the codebase is its own raised its rate of merging duplicated code from under 10% to roughly 50% in small coding-task tests. The finding shows that ownership framing strongly steers whether the model conservatively extends existing structure or actively refactors it.

原文标题：Anthropic 提示词技巧让模型重构代码成功率翻五倍

Why it matters：官方文档给出可量化的提示词效果对比，对日常使用编码智能体的开发者有直接可操作性。

item.title: TSMC October Revenue Jumps 59.7% on Sustained AI Chip Demand
item.description:
TSMC reported October 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$586.89 billion, up 59.7% year over year and 14.7% sequentially, sustaining near-60% growth on a high base. Cumulative January-October revenue reached NT$4.49 trillion, up 43.3% year over year, lending early credibility to its Q4 guidance of $52.3-54.3 billion as AI and HPC demand continues to outstrip supply.

原文标题：台积电 10 月营收 5869 亿新台币 同比增 59.7%

Why it matters：全球最大晶圆代工厂的月度营收是 AI 算力供需与先进制程景气的关键先行指标，直接影响芯片产业链预期。

item.title: Sensing Human Movement Through Walls Using TV Signals
item.description:
Using a software-defined radio to capture a local ATSC digital TV signal, the author found that selective fading makes the signal extremely sensitive to nearby human movement, enabling through-wall motion sensing from an adjacent room via spectrogram changes. The approach needs no special hardware, and wideband signals such as WiFi or LTE can yield the same channel state information.

原文标题：利用电视信号穿墙感知室内人体移动

Why it matters：以低成本软件无线电把日常电视信号变成穿墙人体感知手段，展示了射频感知的实用路径。

item.title: Apple Siri Routes About 2% of English Requests to On-Device AI
item.description:
Apple has introduced a front-end module called Skimmer in the first developer beta of iOS/macOS 27.3, routing roughly 2% of English Siri AI requests to an on-device model for the first time, mainly covering high-frequency fixed commands such as timers, music playback and calls. The module matches preset tool flows via regular expressions and executes directly, bypassing full AI inference to cut latency and protect privacy.

原文标题：苹果 Siri 约 2% 英文请求改由本地模型处理

Why it matters：首次披露苹果 Siri 端侧 AI 调度的具体规则与实现机制，对理解端云协同架构有参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Paper Finds Irrelevant Text Weakens Models via Intrusion Heads
item.description:
A new Nvidia-led paper finds that irrelevant text in RAG, tool-use and long-context prompts hurts models mainly by weakening their use of the question rather than directly suppressing the right answer. The authors identify a small set of 'intrusion heads' inside open models that read unrelated text and dilute the answer; masking about 10 such heads on 7B-scale models recovered 57% of the accuracy lost to distractors on average, versus a 97.6% oracle ceiling.

原文标题：英伟达论文揭示无关文本通过干扰注意力头削弱模型

Why it matters：给出了无关上下文损害模型的可解释机制与免训练修复手段，对 RAG 与长上下文工程有直接指导价值。

item.title: Ex-Toutiao CEO Chen Lin Confirms Departure to Launch AI Education Startup
item.description:
Chen Lin, former CEO of Toutiao and Dali Education, publicly confirmed for the first time that he has left ByteDance and is preparing an AI education startup called Xiaolu Aixue (Galaxy Zhixue). He said the AI shift sparked by ChatGPT, which is gradually replacing professional skills with machines, drove him to rethink how the next generation can achieve lasting growth.

Why it matters：字节系核心高管离职投身 AI 教育创业，属产业人事动向，但尚无产品、技术与融资细节。

item.title: Seele03 Generates Editable Unity and Godot Game Projects
item.description:
Seele AI has released Seele03, a model that works with built-in asset generators to output editable Unity, Godot or web game projects rather than a one-shot game. Its value lies in unifying mesh generation, rigging, sound and code in one place, enabling a build-play-fix iteration loop and cutting integration overhead for small teams.

原文标题：Seele03 直接生成可编辑的 Unity 与 Godot 游戏工程

Why it matters：它把生成式模型接入真实游戏引擎工程流，代表 AI 辅助开发从单次生成转向可迭代的资产与代码管线。

item.title: IBM to Embed Anthropic's Claude Mythos in Concert Protect Scanner
item.description:
IBM plans to embed Anthropic's Claude Mythos into IBM Concert Protect so enterprises can hunt unknown logic flaws and potential zero-days that lack signatures or CVE records. Findings are routed to a Proof of Exploitability step that checks code, configuration and infrastructure for real attacker reachability; in one IBM case this reduced over 5,700 scanner findings to 12 proven exploitable vulnerabilities. Mythos had previously been used only for internal security research via Anthropic's gated Project Glasswing program.

原文标题：IBM 将 Claude Mythos 引入代码漏洞扫描

Why it matters：大模型进入企业代码安全扫描主流程，且给出告警收敛的真实量化案例，对安全与 AI 工程读者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Ultorg Launches Spreadsheet-Style UI for Relational Databases
item.description:
Ultorg released a spreadsheet-like UI for relational databases that lets users query and edit data across tables and relationships without SQL or custom CRUD apps. It supports PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server and BigQuery, with macOS, Windows and Linux clients plus a 14-day free trial.

原文标题：Ultorg 推出关系型数据库电子表格式界面

Why it matters：为关系型数据库提供免 SQL 的电子表格交互层，降低数据查询与编辑门槛，对开发者与数据团队有实际工具价值。

item.title: Zhengyuan Quantum Raises Angel Round to Build Thousand-Qubit Superconducting Quantum Computer
item.description:
Zhengyuan Quantum has closed an angel funding round from investors including Shenzhen Capital Group and Pudong Venture Capital to develop a thousand-qubit superconducting quantum computer. Founded in February 2026, the startup focuses on chip connectivity and control, pursuing TSV 3D packaging, cryogenic interconnects, and integrated measurement and control, and has already received orders for parametric amplifiers and other components.

item.title: Infineon Fabricates World's First 300mm SiC Power Device Wafer
item.description:
Infineon has become the first to process 300mm silicon carbide wafers into power semiconductor devices at full-scale production, using existing silicon equipment at its Villach fab in Austria. The company is advancing its 200mm SiC roadmap and has validated cold-split technology on 12-inch SiC at its Dresden site to cut ingot-to-wafer losses.

原文标题：英飞凌造出全球首个 300mm 碳化硅功率器件晶圆

Why it matters：300mm SiC 器件首次在量产级晶圆厂落地，直接关系功率半导体成本曲线与 AI 数据中心供电基础设施。

Adobe 与华特迪士尼达成多年战略合作，成为其官方 AI 创新合作伙伴，将 Firefly、Firefly Foundry、Premiere 和 Photoshop 的优先使用权引入迪士尼内容制作与主题乐园流程。双方将基于迪士尼角色、场景与视觉风格训练定制生成式模型，并由艺术家主导开发，迪士尼幻想工程已开始用其将手绘草图转为 2D 概念图。

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 登顶生命科学视觉推理榜
item.description:
Artificial Analysis 基于 Handshake AI 的 VIALS 基准构建 VIALS-AA，评测凝胶印迹、质粒图谱、系统发育树等生命科学图像的视觉推理能力。Claude Fable 5.2 以 67% 居首，领先 Gemini 4 Carbon 的 64% 与 GPT-6 Astra 的 63%。更值得关注的是其工具调用策略：Fable 平均每任务约 37 次调用并大量批处理，而 Astra 仅约 8 次，显示推理型模型正走向多步工具编排而非单次作答。

Why it matters：第三方独立评测揭示前沿模型在专业科学视觉推理上的差距，并首次量化工具调用策略差异，对模型选型有直接参考价值。

item.title: 发改委推动具身智能与大模型进入养老领域

item.title: 10 月集成电路出口 395.94 亿美元 同比增 137.1%
item.description:

item.description:
字节跳动发布新一代图像生成模型 Seedream 5.5，在连续 100 轮迭代编辑任务中显著优于 GPT-Image 2.6，后者约第 10 轮即出现明显畸变。新模型同时提升真实感、小字与多语言渲染、透明图生成编辑能力，并下调 API 价格、提升生成速度，已在即梦、豆包及豆包工作上线。

Why it matters：国产图像模型在多轮编辑稳定性上首次公开对标并超越国际头部模型，且伴随降价，对内容生产团队有直接参考价值。

item.title: 蚂蚁灵波开源触觉基础模型 LingBot-Touch
item.description:
蚂蚁灵波科技开源触觉基础模型 LingBot-Touch，基于近 5000 小时真实触觉数据预训练，覆盖磁触觉、视触觉与压阻式三类传感原理，将异构信号统一为同一套触觉表征，可跨传感器、跨灵巧手、跨模型与跨任务复用。在 26 项真机测试中，接入该表征后四种动作模型平均任务成功率提升约 14 至 26 个百分点，拧瓶盖任务成功率由 56.25% 升至 90%。

Why it matters：为具身智能补齐触觉感知这一关键模态，且以开源模型与真机量化结果给出可复用方案。

item.title: 英伟达游说反对限制远程访问芯片
item.description:
据 The Information 报道，两名美国商务部现任官员称，英伟达曾大力游说反对针对远程访问芯片制定任何规则，而中国 AI 实验室正是通过这一途径，使用新加坡和马来西亚数据中心里的受限芯片。这一游说，加上部分官员的反对，曾使美国商务部和国会未能制定新规。10 月下旬，白宫要求国会在《Overwatch Act》中加入条款，强制商务部就特定芯片的远程访问制定规则，并要求收窄《Match Act》的适用范围，使其仅覆盖先进芯片生产，从而放过成熟制程产线。

Why it matters：这条消息披露了美国芯片出口管制中远程访问这一关键漏洞，以及英伟达的游说如何影响政策走向，对关注算力地缘格局的读者有实质信息价值。
